findings.title: Fixed Income agents exist but FI pipeline hasn't run recently
findings.observation: FI research agents are registered but fi_pipeline_report.json is missing.
findings.why_wrong: FI agents without a running FI pipeline produce no picks. The FI pod's $30k capital sits idle.
findings.suggestion: Verify fi_pipeline.py is scheduled in main.py or on GCP cron. Run manually: `python3 fi_pipeline.py`

findings.title: ML / Quantitative: $30,000 capital, zero positions
findings.observation: Pod 'ML / Quantitative' has a $30,000 budget and currently holds $30,000 with zero open positions.
findings.why_wrong: CRO at HIGH may justify caution, but idle capital earns zero return and represents a failure to execute on the pod's mandate.
findings.suggestion: Board should confirm: is this pod intentionally idle (CRO/model readiness) or is it a pipeline failure? If intentional, document why.

findings.title: CRO=HIGH for 17 cycles (68 days) — board must vote
findings.observation: The CRO has been at HIGH for 17 consecutive pipeline cycles (~68 days). During this time, all new buy orders have been blocked. The board last met 999 days ago.
findings.why_wrong: An extended buy block is a major business decision. It should require ongoing board ratification — not just persist automatically. It penalizes research agents for low approved-picks even when they're working correctly.
findings.suggestion: Board should formally vote: (1) Is HIGH still warranted? (2) If yes, what specific condition triggers a downgrade? (3) If no, step down to ELEVATED with 25% cash floor instead of 40%.

findings.title: Board has not met in 999 days despite 3 IRM flags
findings.observation: Last board meeting was 999 days ago. The IRM has 3 active red flag(s). These should have triggered a board session.
findings.why_wrong: IRM flags that sit unaddressed for >7 days represent a governance failure. The board exists to act on them.
findings.suggestion: Trigger a board meeting: `python3 board_meeting.py`. IRM and CRO should be primary agenda items.

findings.title: ML model running but no live picks are being tracked for real-world validation
findings.observation: ml_live_picks_log.json has zero entries. The ST model (AUC=0.6347) is scoring picks but results aren't being captured.
findings.why_wrong: Without tracking real-world picks, we can't validate whether the model's AUC score translates to actual returns. This was explicitly requested by the Chairman.
findings.suggestion: Run `python3 ml_live_test_runner.py --enter` on GCP to begin tracking. Evaluation after 20 days.

findings.title: Key sectors with no active research agent: Energy
findings.observation: The following important sectors have no active research agent: Energy.
findings.why_wrong: Sectors without active agents produce zero picks from those areas. Missing Technology or Financials in particular is a major research blind spot.
findings.suggestion: Chief of Staff should spawn new agents for: Energy. Use the Agent Factory in chief_of_staff_agent.py.
